# TerribleTurtles

> A personal archive of things I've built.

I am a solo developer using the pseudonym TerribleTurtles. This site is a personal archive of things I have built.

## Projects

- [SpellcastersDB](https://terribleturtles.dev/work/spellcastersdb/): Community database and deck builder for Spellcasters Chronicles.
- [Spellcasters Community API](https://terribleturtles.dev/work/spellcasters-community-api/): Free, open-source community API for Spellcasters Chronicles.

## Pages

- [About](https://terribleturtles.dev/about/): About TerribleTurtles and this archive.
- [Privacy](https://terribleturtles.dev/privacy/): Privacy policy and edge infrastructure.
- [Security](https://terribleturtles.dev/security/): Security architecture and vulnerability disclosure.
